subject: Cooking
title: Rancidity: How Fats Go Bad
description: A micro-lesson that makes Rancidity: How Fats Go Bad usable.

hook.text: That old bottle of walnut oil smells like paint. It's not dirty — it's undergone oxidation.

buildup.text: Unsaturated fats are vulnerable — oxygen attacks their double bonds, breaking them into aldehydes.

discovery.text: These aldehydes produce the 'off' smell and are linked to inflammation when consumed.

twist.text: More unsaturated means more vulnerable. Flaxseed oil goes rancid in weeks; coconut oil lasts years.

climax.text: Store oils in dark, cool places and sealed tightly — light, heat, and air all accelerate rancidity.

punchline.text: Healthy oils can become unhealthy just by waiting.

quiz.question: Why do polyunsaturated oils go rancid faster?
options: More double bonds are vulnerable to oxygen

details.summary: Rancidity occurs when fat molecules react with oxygen, breaking into short-chain aldehydes and ketones that smell and taste unpleasant. Unsaturated fats go rancid faster because their double bonds are vulnerable to oxidation. Heat, light, and time accelerate the process.
details.whyItMatters: Rancid fats taste terrible and may produce harmful compounds. Proper storage of oils and nuts depends on understanding what accelerates oxidation.
takeaways: Oxygen breaks double bonds in fats, creating off-flavors
Polyunsaturated oils like flaxseed go rancid fastest
Cool, dark, sealed storage dramatically extends oil shelf life

faq.question: How can you tell if cooking oil has gone rancid?
faq.answer: Rancid oil smells like old paint, crayons, or cardboard. The taste is bitter and sharp. Fresh oil should smell neutral or mildly of its source. If in doubt, taste a small amount — rancidity is immediately obvious. Discard any oil that smells off.

faq.question: Which cooking oils last longest and shortest?
faq.answer: Saturated fats like coconut oil and ghee last years because they lack vulnerable double bonds. Refined olive and avocado oils last about a year. Polyunsaturated oils like walnut and flaxseed go rancid within months and should be refrigerated after opening.
